title: pvGDALVectorReader
body:
## pvGDALVectorReader

Reads one layer of a GIS vector file (Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, GML, DXF and other GDAL vector formats) into polydata: points, lines and polygons with the feature attributes as cell-data arrays. By ParaView default each feature is a separate block of a multiblock dataset; AppendFeatures merges them into one polydata. Use it for outlines, roads, building footprints or measurement locations in GIS formats.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only ActiveLayer (default 0, the first layer) is read; create one node per layer when a file has several.
- Coordinates are in the file's coordinate reference system; nothing is reprojected.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `GDALVectorReader`. Identity: `sources/GDALVectorReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ActiveLayer` | Zero-based index of the layer to read from a multi-layer GDAL vector source (for example one table of a GeoPackage or one layer of a shapefile directory). Only this layer is read unless AppendFeatures combines all layers. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `AddFeatureIds` | Set whether feature IDs should be generated. Some GDAL primitives (e.g., a polygon with a hole in its interior) are represented by multiple VTK cells. If you wish to identify the primitive responsible for a VTK cell, turn this on. It is off by default for backwards compatibility. The array of feature IDs will be the active cell-data pedigree IDs. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AppendFeatures` | Set whether features are appended to a single vtkPolyData. Turning the option on is useful when a shapefile has a number of features which could otherwise lead to a huge multiblock structure. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the GDAL Vector reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGDALVectorReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
